articles.title: Robinhood backs tokenization of its stock on OKX–ICE platform even as most companies opt out
articles.snippet: The brokerage firm said it would rather help build tokenized markets than sit on the sidelines, following a wave of early corporate pushback to the Intercontinental Exchange and OKX joint venture.

articles.title: Google’s AI chip push adds more pressure on Nvidia
articles.snippet: Google’s specialised AI chips threaten greater competition as Nvidia faces a leadership investigation.

articles.title: Coinbase gets full U.S. trust charter from federal banking regulator
articles.snippet: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency elevated the biggest U.S. exchange's trust status from conditional to a full-fledged charter, the company said.

articles.title: SpaceX proposes a $24 billion Texas supercomputer and a gas plant
articles.snippet: The $24 billion project, which includes an AI supercomputer in Texas with its own gas-fired power plant, is about 17 times the value of SpaceX's bitcoin holdings.

articles.title: Bitcoin, tech stocks brush off Nvidia nerves as analyst mulls $68K target
articles.snippet: Bitcoin rebounded from an 11-week low near $73,500 as the Nasdaq Composite rallied despite sell-off in Nvidia shares.
